name: opencode-orchestrator
description: Distributed Cognitive Architecture for OpenCode. Turns simple prompts into specialized multi-agent workflows (Planner, Coder, Reviewer).
author: agnusdei1207

scripts.docker:build-all: docker compose run --rm dev && docker compose run --rm rust-arm64 && docker compose run --rm win-builder
scripts.docker:rust-dist: docker compose run --rm dev && docker compose run --rm rust-arm64 && (sudo chown -R $(id -u):$(id -g) bin/ 2>/dev/null || true)
scripts.build:all: npm run build && npm run docker:rust-dist
scripts.test:all: npm run build && vitest run --reporter=verbose && echo '=== ALL TESTS PASSED ==='
scripts.release:patch: node scripts/release-auth-check.mjs && node scripts/release-version.mjs patch && npm run release:preflight && npm run docker:rust-dist && npm run publish:token
scripts.release:minor: node scripts/release-auth-check.mjs && node scripts/release-version.mjs minor && npm run release:preflight && npm run docker:rust-dist && npm run publish:token
scripts.release:major: node scripts/release-auth-check.mjs && node scripts/release-version.mjs major && npm run release:preflight && npm run docker:rust-dist && npm run publish:token
scripts.release:push-tags: git push origin main && git push origin --tags
scripts.release:clean: shx rm -rf dist bin && docker compose down -v
scripts.reset:local: brew uninstall opencode 2>/dev/null; rm -rf ~/.config/opencode ~/.opencode ~/.local/share/opencode ~/.cache/opencode/node_modules/opencode-orchestrator && echo '=== Clean done ===' && brew install opencode && echo '{"plugin": ["opencode-orchestrator"], "$schema": "https://opencode.ai/config.json"}' > ~/.config/opencode/opencode.json && echo '=== Reset (Dev) complete. Run: opencode ==='
scripts.reset:prod: brew uninstall opencode 2>/dev/null; rm -rf ~/.config/opencode ~/.opencode ~/.local/share/opencode ~/.cache/opencode/node_modules/opencode-orchestrator && echo '=== Clean done ===' && brew install opencode && echo '{"plugin": ["opencode-orchestrator"], "$schema": "https://opencode.ai/config.json"}' > ~/.config/opencode/opencode.json && npm run cleanup:plugin && npm uninstall -g opencode-orchestrator && echo '=== Reset (Prod) complete. Run: opencode ==='
